aciklama: Tekrar eden kişi, hayvan ve nesnelerin sabit görünüş kartları. Her istemde ilgili kartın `en` metni harfiyen kullanılır (tools/istem_devir.py). `kaynak`: görünüşün dayandığı yer. `secim`: kaynakta olmayıp yalnız görseller arası tutarlılık için sabitlenen ayrıntılar; Erdem onaylayınca kesinleşir. Kaynakla çelişen bir görsel ya da kartla uyuşmayan bir görsel kabul edilmez.

abdulmuttalib.en: Abdul-Muttalib, chief of Quraysh: an elderly man of about 75, tall, upright and imposing, with a handsome, dignified face and a few deep lines; a full, neatly kept, fist-length beard and moustache, grey-white (light grey with white streaks), no black hairs; an off-white head cloth falling to his shoulders, held by a dark brown cord band; a cream-white ankle-length tunic; over it a long open rust-brown cloak with a broad saffron-yellow border; brown leather sandals.
abdulmuttalib.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 34: yakışıklı, heybetli. TDV ABDÜLMUTTALİB: 82 yaşında öldü (577) → Fil Vakası (570-571) sırasında ~75; yaşlılık bundan çıkarıldı.
abdulmuttalib.secim: Sakal biçimi ve rengi (gri-beyaz, yumruk boyu), kıyafet renkleri. b02'deki dört görseldeki görünüşe göre sabitlendi.

ebrehe.en: Abraha, the Abyssinian ruler of Yemen: a short, stout, heavy-set man of about 60 with dark brown skin; a split scar running vertically through his upper lip and the tip of his nose; short, tightly curled black hair and a short, close-cropped curly black beard streaked with grey; a cream-white ankle-length tunic with a wide dark-brown sash; over it a large deep-red cloak with a narrow golden-yellow border, draped over both shoulders; brown leather sandals; no crown, no jewels, no cross, no animal skin.
ebrehe.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 28: kısa boylu, etli; s. 29: el-Eşrem (yüzü yarık). TDV EBREHE: dudağı veya burnu yarıldı; 525'te Eryât'ın ordusundaydı → 570'te en az ~60 yaşında. Habeşli.
ebrehe.secim: Saç, sakal biçimi, kıyafet renkleri (b02'deki görüşme ve Sakîf görsellerine göre). Yaşın gri sakalla gösterilmesi Erdem kararı bekliyor.

abdullah.en: Abdullah, a slim young Arab man of about 18, ALWAYS seen strictly from behind (back of the head and back only, no face, no profile, no cheek); a plain off-white head cloth held by a dark brown cord band; a plain light sand-grey knee-length tunic with a brown belt; brown sandals.
abdullah.kaynak: TDV ABDULLAH: ~18 yaşında evlendi ve öldü. Temsil kuralı 3: yüz yok.

vehb.en: Wahb ibn Abd Manaf, chief of the Banu Zuhra: a dignified man of about 55 with a short, neat dark-brown beard with a little grey; an off-white head cloth with a dark brown cord band; a cream tunic and a long brown cloak without a coloured border.
vehb.kaynak: TDV ÂMİNE: Benî Zühre reisi. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

amine.en: Amina, a woman ALWAYS seen from behind or completely in shadow, face never visible; wrapped in a long deep indigo-blue cloak with a sand-coloured head covering that hides her hair and the sides of her face.
amine.kaynak: Temsil kuralı 3: yüz yok. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

halime.en: Halima, a Bedouin woman ALWAYS seen from behind or completely in shadow, face never visible; wrapped in a long dark brown woven cloak with a black head covering.
halime.kaynak: Temsil kuralı 3: yüz yok. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

haris.en: Al-Harith, Halima's husband, a lean Bedouin man of about 40 with a short black beard; a faded indigo head cloth wrapped loosely without a cord; a plain undyed wool tunic; barefoot or simple sandals.
haris.kaynak: TDV HALÎME: Halîme'nin kocası. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

ummu_eymen.en: Umm Ayman, an Abyssinian woman, seen from behind in these scenes; wrapped in a long sand-beige cloak with a brown head covering.

ebu_talib.en: Abu Talib, a man of about 42 with a full, short black beard; an off-white head cloth with a dark brown cord band; a cream tunic and a long olive-brown cloak with a thin dark border; brown sandals.
ebu_talib.kaynak: TDV EBÛ TÂLİB: 535 doğumlu → babası öldüğünde (577) ~42. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

hunata.en: Hunata, a Himyarite envoy from Yemen: a man of about 45 with a short black beard; a dark-red head wrap tied as a turban; a cream tunic and a long dark-red cloak.
hunata.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 34: Himyerli elçi. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

nufeyl.en: Nufayl ibn Habib of Khath'am, the army's guide: an Arab man of about 45 with a short dark beard; an off-white head cloth wrapped loosely without a cord; a cream tunic and a red cloak with a narrow white edge.
nufeyl.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 31-32, 35; TDV FİL VAK'ASI: Has'am reisi, kılavuz. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

zu_nefer.en: Dhu Nafar, a Yemeni nobleman held captive: a man of about 50 with a short greying beard; a white head cloth with a dark cord; a beige tunic and a brown cloak; hands bound in front of him with a simple rope.
zu_nefer.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 31: esir. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

habes_askeri.en: Abyssinian soldiers: dark-brown-skinned men, short black hair under a plain white cloth cap, short black beards; cream knee-length tunics, a simple brown leather vest, a red shoulder cloak; each holds at most one plain wooden spear; no helmets, no shields, no banners, no crosses.
habes_askeri.kaynak: Habeşli ordu (İbn Hişâm s. 31). Donanım kaynakta yok.
habes_askeri.secim: b02'deki askerlere göre sabitlendi; deri yelek ve mızrak kaynakta yok, Erdem onayı gerek.

kureysli.en: men of Quraysh: Arab men of mixed ages in simple 6th-century clothes: off-white or sand head cloths, plain tunics and long cloaks in muted brown, grey-blue, ochre and undyed wool; no bright colours, no jewellery.

abdulmuttalib_ogullari.en: the sons of Abdul-Muttalib: grown men aged roughly 20 to 50, all clearly younger than their father; mixed beard lengths, all beards black or dark brown except the eldest with a little grey; off-white or sand head cloths and plain cloaks in muted brown, grey-blue and ochre.
abdulmuttalib_ogullari.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 97: hepsi yetişkin (onu koruyacak yaşa geldiler). TDV: Abdullah en küçükleri.

fil.en: Mahmud, the single war elephant: one large grey African elephant with long ivory tusks; a red saddle cloth with a broad golden-yellow border and a row of yellow tassels on its back; no tower, no rider seat, no armour, no second elephant.
fil.kaynak: TDV FİL VAK'ASI: Mahmûd adlı fil; kaynakların çoğu tek fil der.
fil.secim: Örtü rengi (b02-fil-coken'e göre). Renk kaynakta yok.

kuslar.en: flocks of small swallow-like birds with forked tails: dark brown backs and wings, pale cream bellies, simple paper shapes; each carries a tiny reddish pebble in its beak or claws; no fire, no glow.
kuslar.kaynak: Fîl 105/3-4; İbn Hişâm s. 35: kırlangıç benzeri. TDV FİL VAK'ASI: kırmızı çizgili taş.
kuslar.secim: Kuş rengi kaynakta yok; b02-kuslar'a göre sabitlendi.

varaka.en: Waraqa ibn Nawfal, a man of about 60 with a long grey beard; an off-white head cloth with a dark cord; a cream tunic and a long dark-grey cloak.
varaka.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 143 (dört kişiden biri). TDV VARAKA: ilk vahiyde âmâ ve ihtiyar (605'ten sonra; bu sahnede görme belirtilmez).

ubeydullah.en: Ubaydallah ibn Jahsh, a young man of about 25 with a short black beard; a sand-coloured head cloth with a brown cord; a light tunic and an ochre cloak.
ubeydullah.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 143. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

osman_huveyris.en: Uthman ibn al-Huwayrith, a man of about 40 with a medium black beard; a white head cloth with a dark cord; a cream tunic and a grey-blue cloak.
osman_huveyris.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 143. Görünüş kaynakta yok.

zeyd_amr.en: Zayd ibn Amr, a man of about 50 with a full, medium-length dark beard with grey at the chin; an undyed off-white head cloth without a cord; a plain undyed wool tunic and a simple brown cloak.
zeyd_amr.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 143; Buhârî 3827. Yaş kaynakta yok.

zeyd_amr_yasli.en: Zayd ibn Amr in old age: an old man of about 70 with a full white beard; the same undyed off-white head cloth without a cord, plain undyed wool tunic and simple brown cloak as in his younger days.
zeyd_amr_yasli.kaynak: İbn Hişâm s. 144: şeyh kebîr; Buhârî 3828.
